invariants.rule: compute(ctx) must not raise on any market-data shape.
compute(ctx) must not modify the input snapshot in place — the same ChainSnapshot is shared across all plots in a live tick, so mutating it corrupts every other plot and breaks replay determinism.
the return must be {'value': number} or {'series': {name: number, ...}}.
every returned number must be finite (no NaN / inf).

cases.name: empty_chain
cases.description: Zero options in the chain. count()==0 → any division by a count/sum blows up.

cases.name: single_call_only
cases.description: Exactly one CALL, no PUTs. Put-side aggregations are empty.

cases.name: single_put_only
cases.description: Exactly one PUT, no CALLs. Call-side aggregations are empty.

cases.name: calls_only
cases.description: Several CALLs, zero PUTs. put_qty==0 → call/put ratios divide by zero.

cases.name: puts_only
cases.description: Several PUTs, zero CALLs. call_qty==0 → put/call ratios divide by zero.

cases.name: single_book_level
cases.description: Only L1 exists. Accessing bid_price_l2 / _l3 hits missing levels.

cases.name: no_book_levels
cases.description: Book has zero levels per side. Every _l1 access is out of range.

cases.name: large_dense_chain
cases.description: 100 options (50C/50P), 3 levels. Stresses per-tick cost and accumulation.

cases.name: all_nan_book_prices
cases.description: Every bid/ask price is NaN. mean(bid_price_l1) → NaN unless guarded.

cases.name: all_nan_greeks
cases.description: delta/gamma/vega/theta/iv all NaN (greek-engine outage).

cases.name: all_nan_iv
cases.description: Every IV is NaN. mean(iv) → NaN; IV-based indicators must use nz()/safe defaults.

cases.name: some_nan_iv
cases.description: Half the IVs are NaN (partial outage). Mixed NaN/finite aggregation.

cases.name: nan_underlying
cases.description: underlying_price is NaN. Any moneyness/ratio vs underlying → NaN.

cases.name: all_nan_quantities
cases.description: Every bid/ask quantity is NaN. nansum→0 but ratios of NaN qty can surprise.

cases.name: all_zero_quantities
cases.description: All bid/ask quantities are 0. sum==0 → imbalance ratios divide by zero.

cases.name: all_zero_prices
cases.description: All prices are 0. Division by price and log(price) blow up.

cases.name: zero_volume
cases.description: volume_since_day_start and traded value are 0. VWAP-style divide by volume.

cases.name: zero_underlying
cases.description: underlying_price is 0. K/S and log(K/S) blow up.

cases.name: all_zero_everything
cases.description: Maximum divide-by-zero exposure: prices, quantities, greeks, volume all 0.

cases.name: flat_strikes
cases.description: All strikes identical. Strike-spread / skew-vs-strike calcs degenerate.

cases.name: flat_prices
cases.description: All mid/bid/ask prices identical. spread==0, range==0 → range-normalisation /0.

cases.name: flat_delta
cases.description: All deltas identical. std(delta)==0 → zscore divides by zero std.

cases.name: identical_options
cases.description: Every row identical (zero cross-sectional variance everywhere).

cases.name: extreme_large_values
cases.description: Huge prices/quantities (1e15+). Products can overflow to inf.

cases.name: extreme_small_values
cases.description: Tiny values (1e-15). Divide-by-near-zero produces huge/inf results.

cases.name: negative_prices
cases.description: Negative bid/ask/mid prices (bad feed). log()/sqrt() → domain errors / NaN.

cases.name: negative_greeks_extreme
cases.description: Out-of-range greeks (delta=-5, gamma=-3). Sign/range assumptions break.

cases.name: inf_prices
cases.description: +inf bid/ask prices. inf propagates through any arithmetic.

cases.name: neg_inf_prices
cases.description: -inf bid prices. -inf propagates; min()/comparisons surprise.

cases.name: all_no_quote
cases.description: has_quote is False everywhere. Filtering has_quote=True yields an empty set.

cases.name: mixed_quote
cases.description: has_quote alternates. has_quote=True selects a sparse subset.

cases.name: normal_realistic
cases.description: Healthy 4C/4P chain with 3 book levels. Sanity baseline — should always pass.

cases.name: normal_two_expiries
cases.description: Healthy chain spanning two expiries. Baseline for expiry-filtered indicators.
